# Aspen II Homes

> Licensed custom and semi-custom home builder serving Kern County, California since 1994. Builds six semi-custom floor plans from 1,507 to 2,444 sq ft on customer-owned or builder-owned lots.

## Core Facts
- Legal name: Aspen II Homes, Inc.
- Common names: Aspen II Homes, Aspen 2 Homes
- Founded: 1994 (31 years of local building experience)
- California contractor license: CSLB #1004058 (Class B, General Building Contractor), active through 2027-05-31
- Bond: Hudson Insurance Company
- Workers' Compensation: State Compensation Insurance Fund
- Better Business Bureau (BBB): Rated A+
- Phone: (661) 238-3136
- Email: hello@aspen2homes.com
- Physical Address: 30330 Horsethief Dr, Tehachapi, CA 93561
- Geographic coordinates: 35.090843, -118.669640
- Primary service areas: Tehachapi, California City, Ridgecrest, Golden Hills, Bear Valley Springs, Stallion Springs (Kern County, CA)
- Price range: approximately $449,000 to $590,000 (spec homes and semi-custom builds)
- Typical build timeline: 7 to 10 months from signed contract to move-in

## Floor Plans
- Tranquil Oasis: 1,507 sq ft, 3 bed, 2 bath, 2-car garage, single story
- Sunset Retreat: 1,644 sq ft, 3 bed, 2 bath, 2-car garage, covered patio
- The Tranquil Abode: 1,764 sq ft, 3 bed, 2 bath, 2-car garage, split primary suite
- Sunrise View Residence: 2,010 sq ft, 4 bed, 2.5 bath, 2-car garage, flex room
- Enchanted Haven: 2,180 sq ft, 4 bed, 3 bath, 3-car garage, dual suite option
- The Grand Haven: 2,444 sq ft, 4 bed, 3 bath, 3-car garage, executive layout

## Warranty & Quality Assurance
- 1 year workmanship & materials (cabinets, trim, drywall, finishes, fixtures)
- 2 years mechanical & distribution systems (plumbing, electrical, HVAC)
- 10 years structural components (foundation, load-bearing framing)
- Scheduled 11-month post-closing walkthrough included with every home

## Specialized Programs
- Build on Your Lot: Comprehensive site feasibility review including setbacks, slope analysis, septic/well or utility availability, and Kern County zoning prior to contract.
- Heroes of the Nation: Dedicated housing options and pricing incentives for active-duty military personnel, veterans, and defense community families at Edwards Air Force Base and NAWS China Lake.
